Name: Under My Umbrella-ella
Author: DrSpartacus
Description:
Yeah, so pretty much exactly what it says on the tin. When it's raining and NPCs are walking around outside, they'll pop up a little umbrella-ella.

Some things to keep in mind:
[list]
[*]This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, but you'll need to enable that option in GMCM - it's set to off by default.
[*]This mod does its thing by using Content Patcher to add an overlay to the character sprites when certain conditions are met. If you don't quite understand what that means, it's ok just keep in mind that this mod may conflict with other mods that alter the appearance of NPCs.
[*]Just on conflicts - I've tested this with "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic" and it seems to work well alongside it. If you do notice any weirdness though leave me a comment.
[*]I have no idea if this mod is compatible with Android or multiplayer. I'd be grateful if someone could test that for me, but if it's not compatible I'm not sure I know how to fix it.
[*]The sprites aren't perfect yet but I'll aim to do a better looking one next release if there's interest.
[*]Umbrellas-ellas only come in two colours at the moment (Yellow and Black). I'll add more options next release controllable with GMCM.
[*]Any suggestions you have for improvements or changes may be considered... or they may not.
[/list]
Also, if I’m not responsive in the comments section, please don't take it personally, I just tend not to check in that regularly.

Artwork in the pics is by Leonid Afremov if anyone is interested - really cool stuff especially if you're a pluviophile like me.
https://afremov.com/
